text: I say, what's the matter?” The pictures he spoke of were on the front page, and Dick was staring at one of them with his eyes and mouth open, and his sharp face almost pale with excitement. “What's to pay, Dick?” said the young man. “What has paralyzed you?” Dick really did look as if something tremendous had happened. He pointed to the picture, under which was written: “Mother of Claimant (Lady Fauntleroy).” It was the picture of a handsome woman, with large eyes and heavy braids of black hair wound around her head. “Her!” said Dick.
